newsitem.title: USA: Eastern holders turn back Millbrook slate.
newsitem.headline: Eastern holders turn back Millbrook slate.

text.p: Millbrook Capital Management Inc on Wednesday said Eastern Co's shareholders defeated its bid to place three Millbrook nominees on the company's board.
Millbrook's MMI Investments, which owns 6.61 percent of Eastern, is evaluating its alternatives, Millbrook said.

Millbrook's alternatives include calling a special shareholder meeting this summer, increasing or decreasing its stake or revising its $15-a-share offer to acquire the lock and security equipment supplier, Millbrook said.
Officials at Eastern Co was not immediately available for comment.
Millbrook is an investment firm owned by John Dyson, a former deputy mayor of New York City.
Eastern Co makes high security locks, hardware, steel reinforcing bars and mine roof fasteners.
